build_ImageBertEmbeddings: build an ImageBertEmbeddings module that projects image features into BERT embedding space with CLS and SEP tokens
build_MultimodalBertEncoder: build a MultimodalBertEncoder that fuses image and text embeddings through a shared BERT encoder
build_MultimodalBertClf: build a MultimodalBertClf classifier that combines image and text inputs for multimodal classification
review_ImageBertEmbeddings_forward: review the ImageBertEmbeddings forward pass that concatenates CLS, image, and SEP token embeddings
review_MultimodalBertEncoder_forward: review the MultimodalBertEncoder forward pass that encodes concatenated image and text embeddings through BERT
